### Set Up

```{r}
### load packages
library(fs)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
### read in data

#dropbox file path set up
dropbox_path <- path_home("Dropbox", "Stella", "data") 

# chemicals
chemicals <- read.csv(dropbox_path/"catch.csv") 

# bugs
Hengill <- read_excel(dropbox_path/"Hengill Fall 2013.xlsx")


bugs <- read.csv2(dropbox_path/"inverts.csv") %>%
  mutate(year = as.factor(year),
         stream = as.factor(stream))
```

# Data Cleaning
```{r}
chemicals_clean <- chemicals %>%
  filter(Stream %in% c("is1", "is2", "is3", "is4", "is5", "is6", "is7"))
```

# Preliminary Analysis
```{r}
chemicals_clean %>%
  group_by(Stream, Depth) %>%
  summarise(mean_SRP = mean(SRP))

chemicals_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = SRP, x = Stream, color = Depth)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
